accuracy_interpretation: Report signed error, absolute microseconds, median, tail quantiles and bands by actual source implementation. The 10% column is a reference target, not a reason to remove a measured point.
calibration: Nonnegative primitive costs fitted jointly to measured kernel latency and PMU constraints; costs are shared within actual source implementations. Actual latency is a training target, never a prediction input.

kernel=same_ab|dtype=BF16|layout=BNSD|ma.calibration: Shared nonnegative source-operation rates within this implementation, fitted jointly to kernel times and PMU constraints. Scalar active time is an upper bound, since wait/control is already represented in the graph. Entire shapes and all their tilings must stay in the same validation fold.

phase_costs: Stage resource demands are reconstructed, not independently timed. PMU Scalar busy time includes waits and is only an upper bound. Stage resource sums are not stage wall times.

phase_model.interpretation: Critical-path time contributions are model estimates; PMU active sums span the whole kernel and cannot uniquely attribute a residual to an individual phase.
phase_model.q_reload: First S2 window only for each Q block in TND L1 carry

scope: Existing dense and uniform-TND SameAB implementations; FP16/BF16, observed layouts, NORMAL/UNSPLITK, with and without dropout. No fallback to another kernel implementation.
